description: Chintu aur Mithu saath milkar ek pyara sa blanket fort banate hain. Is gaane se bachhe shapes aur naram-mulayam textures ke baare mein seekhenge.

scenes.text:

Chintu's fort is soft and wide, come and sleep inside.
scenes.image_prompt: A cute round orange baby elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot with a yellow tummy and red cap sitting inside a cozy blanket fort made of pillows.

scenes.text:
नीली चादर ऊपर तानी, मखमली है इसकी निशानी।
Blue blanket acts like a roof, soft and cozy is the proof.
scenes.image_prompt: A blue soft blanket draped over chairs creating a dark, comfy indoor tent.

scenes.text:

scenes.text:
